subject: Speaker rights, live captions & transcript release — Redwood Live
messages:
From: irene.choi@redwood.ai
To: priya@brightmind.ai
Cc: laura.bennett@redwood.ai, karthik.iyer@redwood.ai, lauren.bishop@redwood.ai
Date: Mon, 16 Nov 2026 09:22:00 -0800
Subject: Speaker rights, live captions & transcript release — Redwood Live

Hi Priya —

Thanks again for agreeing to join our Redwood Live session on Dec 2. A few quick coordination items so we can finalize the run-of-show and publishing permissions: 

1) Slides: could you upload the final deck to the shared Drive folder linked below by Wednesday (Nov 18)? We made a placeholder named BrightMind_Speaker_Slides_v3.pptx. If you prefer we pull from your repo, let us know the file link.

2) Recording & transcript: we record the session and produce a searchable transcript. We need explicit consent to publish the transcript and 90-second clip excerpts on Redwood channels (blog, YouTube short). I attached a short Speaker_Release_Form_BrightMind.pdf — please sign via DocuSign or return a signed PDF.

3) Live captions & accessibility: we offer live captions and can arrange an ASL interpreter; please tell us if you want that. If yes, fill the ASL_Interpreter_Request_Form.pdf (attached) and we’ll schedule.

4) Accessibility slides: if you have graphics with small text, we’ll need alt text or a short description for each slide. We can do a quick alt-text pass if you send source images.

5) Run-of-show: we’re planning 5 min host intro, 25 min conversation, 10 min Q&A. Would you like the Q&A to be freeform or curated by us?

Drive link: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/0Axyz-redwood/webinar/brightmind-prep

If you’re okay, we’ll also ask marketing to draft the 1-paragraph bio and a headshot request.

Appreciate a quick confirm on the transcript release and captioning preference — I’ll follow up with the DocuSign link.

Best,
Irene Choi
Programs | Redwood Inference
irene.choi@redwood.ai
+1 (415) 555-0198
From: priya@brightmind.ai
To: irene.choi@redwood.ai
Cc: t.ellis@brightmind.ai
Date: Tue, 17 Nov 2026 11:05:00 -0500
Subject: Re: Speaker rights, live captions & transcript release — Redwood Live

Hi Irene —

Thanks — excited to participate. Quick answers: 

- Slides: I’ll upload the final deck (and a separate slide with alt text notes) to the Drive by end of day Nov 18. 
- Transcript & clips: I’m fine with Redwood publishing the transcript and up to 90-second clips as long as BrightMind is credited and we approve the clip before publishing. Is that an additional approval step?
- Captions/ASL: Yes to live captions. We don’t need ASL for this session but appreciate the offer.
- Q&A: Let’s do curated Q&A — please send questions in advance or pick 3 audience questions live and keep 2 for overflow.

I can sign the release; please send the DocuSign link to my email.

Best,
Dr. Priya Raj
Chief Research Officer, BrightMind AI
priya@brightmind.ai
From: laura.bennett@redwood.ai
To: priya@brightmind.ai, irene.choi@redwood.ai
Cc: karthik.iyer@redwood.ai, lauren.bishop@redwood.ai, soojin.lee@redwood.ai
Date: Wed, 18 Nov 2026 08:42:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Speaker rights, live captions & transcript release — Redwood Live

Hi all —

Thanks Priya, sounds good. Quick clarifications from ops: 

- Approval workflow for clips: we will send the selected 90-second clip to you for review and require signoff within 48 hours of receipt; if we don’t hear back we’ll hold publishing. Noted that BrightMind must be credited — that will be standard.

- DocuSign: Irene, I uploaded the release envelope (Speaker_Release_Form_BrightMind.pdf) to DocuSign; Priya you should have an invite with envelopeId=ABC123-RELEASE. If you prefer a signed PDF, send it here and we’ll attach it to the record.

- Accessibility: Priya, thanks for the alt text offer. If you upload alt text in the same folder we’ll run a preflight. Also we’ll enable live captions via our vendor (Otter.ai integration) and will include a participant-facing toggle.

- Run-of-show note: we’ll block a 10-minute tech-check window 30 minutes before the session for host + speaker audio checks and to confirm captions are streaming correctly.

Attachments: BrightMind_Speaker_Slides_v3.pptx (placeholder), Speaker_Release_Form_BrightMind.pdf, ASL_Interpreter_Request_Form.pdf

Laura Bennett
Event Operations | Redwood Inference
laura.bennett@redwood.ai
From: irene.choi@redwood.ai
To: priya@brightmind.ai
Cc: laura.bennett@redwood.ai, karthik.iyer@redwood.ai, lauren.bishop@redwood.ai, soojin.lee@redwood.ai
Date: Sun, 29 Nov 2026 16:04:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Speaker rights, live captions & transcript release — Redwood Live

Hi Priya —

Great, thanks for the quick turnaround. Two final items before we lock the public page: 

1) Bio & headshot: Marketing drafted a 1-line and a 2‑sentence blurb — I attached the draft in Drive. If you can approve or edit by EOD Nov 30 we’ll publish the registration page.

2) On approval timing for clip signoff: we confirm we will not publish any clip without your signoff. If 48 hours is tight, we can extend to 72 hours for BrightMind. Please confirm preference.

Tech-check: Please plan to join the tech-check on Dec 2 at 12:30 PM PST (session starts 1:00 PM PST). Agenda for tech-check: mic/echo check, captions verification, slide upload sanity, and host signal testing.

DocuSign link (if you didn’t get it): https://www.docusign.com/en/signer?envelopeId=ABC123-RELEASE

Thanks again — excited to feature BrightMind on the show.

Best,
Irene
Programs | Redwood Inference
